def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    interest_paid = 36000
    mortgage_debt = 900000
    acquisition_date = "2020-01-10"
    filing_status = "single"
    cutoff_date = "2017-12-15"
    
    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    if acquisition_date <= cutoff_date:
        debt_limit = 1000000
    elif filing_status == "married filing separately":
        debt_limit = 375000
    else:
        debt_limit = 750000

    deductible_interest = interest_paid * min(1, debt_limit / mortgage_debt)
    answer = round(deductible_interest)
    
    # return answer
